title: Grateful Dead Live at San Francisco State University on 1966-10-02

ai_review.summary: A polarizing tape fragment that intrigues some listeners but is dismissed as trash by others, with no concrete details on sound source or musical highlights.
ai_review.review: The four reviews are split between enthusiastic praise of the historical curiosity of this recording and outright condemnation calling it nonsense. No reviewer identifies the source (soundboard, audience, etc.) or mentions specific songs or band performance, leaving both the audio fidelity and the show itself largely undefined.

ai_rating.rationale: Overall star average is 3.75; mixed comments give a modest rating despite lack of concrete performance or technical details.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit remarks about clarity, mix, or source type; one reviewer references the magnetic tape itself, suggesting an old analog capture with unknown fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers give no information on set structure or song flow.
